title: Ensure build workers are automatically scanned for vulnerabilities
description: Workers run other people's code by design, so a known-vulnerable kernel or runtime on one is an escalation waiting for its build to arrive. Whatever scans them — image scanning in a registry, host agents — reports somewhere other than the Jenkins API.
remediation: Scan the sources workers are built from, automatically: container images in the registry pipeline (and gate agent templates on the result), VM images with the platform's assessment tooling, long-lived hosts with a scanning agent. Wire findings to rebuilds, so a vulnerable worker's remaining lifetime is one provisioning cycle.
fixSummary: Scan agent images in the registry and rebuild on findings.
